note: Alan's idle cigarette, as Game I (js/engine/smoke.js: after 20 s without input he lights up, then drag / breathe out / hold round and round; the engine draws the smoke from his mouth and the tip; any input puts it out). The four poses are painted (art/review/alan_smoke/alanv_smoke_*.webp, Higgsfield gpt_image_2_5 high from alanv_side_k and Game I's alan_smoke_* as pose references; originals in art/designs/alan_smoke/). These are the Ludo in-betweens between them, standing -> light and hold -> standing so it starts and ends on his standing sprite. The poses are read from art/review/alan_smoke/ (ludo.py's '../review/...' keyframe path), so nothing goes into art/sprites/ before approval. Not run: needs LUDO_API_KEY in the root .env. The user, 2026-10-31: the cigarette stays in one hand (Game I's switched hands, wrong): his right, the near arm, in every pose after the light (both hands cupped at the match) and in every in-between.

runs.name: alanv_smoke_stand_light
